ash: midnight async check-in — quick sync for edge regions (eu/apac). What I did: pushed node-redriver canary to eu-west1 (2 nodes), kicked off prefix-KV warmup lambda. Blockers: apac quota still at 85%, can't provision p4d instances in async pool. Today: opening quota ticket + trying g5 fallback in sg-region, pinged billing.
lucy: saw the canary graphs — p50 improved ~12% for small requests, nice. :thumbsup: On apac quota I already filed support ticket (cloud ref INC-2931). For g5 fallback, suggest dropping batch_size default to 8 to avoid OOM on smaller cards.
raj: on-call — I'll take the quota ticket triage. FYI spot-eviction spikes in sg1 at ~02:10 UTC last night, attaching short log excerpt.
ops-bot: Deploy job 8034561245: canary -> prod gate passed. Metrics snapshot: p50 42ms, p95 120ms. :white_check_mark:
natalie: small ops ask — can we freeze any model rollouts onto dedicated apac pools until fallback is validated? I can hold release if yes.
ash: (typo correction) ash: yes — freeze rollouts for apac dedicated pools for now. Raj, coordinate the drain test after quota ticket moves. Lucy, can you open a tiny PR to change edge overlay default batch_size -> 8 and link it here?
lucy: opened PR: https://git.internal/r/789 — edits to edge-configmap and a comment about batching rationale. @raj PTAL, it's a 3-line change.
raj: reviewing now, should be quick. I'll also add an ops runbook note about the sg1 eviction pattern and a scheduled drain test once quota bump is confirmed.
ash: thanks — I'll update the statusboard and post a brief note in #incidents if anything regresses. /cc @infra-sre for awareness.
